notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

===

Minor Change
[list]
[*]Temporary removal of the Ghost Button
[*]This feature has been not working due to api issues. I am removing the ghosts until I can resolve the issues and make sure they are working as intended.
[*] I am also looking into changing the way ghosts are added and looking into using steams user data feature to do so.  Thank you for your patience in this and I appreciate all the players who have been setting times in the Doggo Leaderboards!
[/list]

notes.title: Steam Leaderboard Integration
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

===

Major Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed stuttering issue when landing on snails.

[*]Fixed local scores not saving properly.
[/list]

Major Changes
[list]
[*]Implemented Steam Leaderboards

[*]Added a migration button on main menu for players who are logged in to old leaderboards. This migration takes about 10 minutes. Please do not exit the game during this time.
[*]Migration tool will be removed in a future update. Please make sure you migrate as soon as possible
[/list]

Minor Changes
[list]
[*]Added one achievement
[*]Implemented Steam Cloud for config files
[/list]

===

Thank you again everyone that has played Doggo! I am excited to continue development!!

notes.title: Update notes for Feb 16
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

===

Major Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where if you clicked the ghost button multiple times it would crash the game. As well as added a loading notice when loading in ghosts.

[*]Fixed loading credits from the pause menu or finish menu that would cause an infinite black screen.
[/list]

Minor Changes
[list]
[*]Changed ghost opacity and local ghost color enabling the dog and hat to be more noticeable.

[*]Added collectable bones and faster controls to the credits scene. Added the ability to walk on credits.
[*]note: Collectable bones on credits have no function yet. This full feature is still being worked on.
[/list]

===

Thank you everyone that has played the game.
I will continue placing Doggo as a top priority and I hope you all will continue to enjoy Doggo in the future.
I appreciate the support so much and making this game has been a dream come true!
